b2-szamizdat-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Three Ts
b2-szamizdat-01.scenario: At a literary evening in Budapest, a visiting student asks you how the 'three Ts' cultural policy of the Kádár era worked.
b2-szamizdat-01.prompt: Tell her into which categories works were sorted, and what the 'tolerated' category meant.
cues: Say what could happen to a tolerated work
b2-szamizdat-01.target: A műveket a támogatott, a tűrt vagy a tiltott kategóriába sorolták. A tűrt művek megjelenhettek, de csak korlátozottan.
b2-szamizdat-01.english: Works were sorted into the supported, the tolerated or the prohibited category. Tolerated works could appear, but only to a limited extent.
b2-szamizdat-01.canDo: I can explain how György Aczél's 'three Ts' (támogatott, tűrt, tiltott) cultural policy worked in Kádár-era Hungary.

b2-szamizdat-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Bargain with the Censor
b2-szamizdat-02.scenario: At a publishers' evening in Budapest, a young editor asks you, according to the memoirs, what a writer could expect when György Aczél negotiated with him.
b2-szamizdat-02.prompt: Tell her what could happen to a book if the writer agreed to cuts, and what if he refused.
cues: Say what an agreeing writer could expect
Say what a refusing writer faced
b2-szamizdat-02.target: Ha a szerző töröl néhány vitatott bekezdést, a könyv megjelenhet. Ha megtagadja az együttműködést, a kézirat fiókban marad, az útlevélkérelme pedig elutasításra kerül.
b2-szamizdat-02.english: If the author deletes a few disputed paragraphs, the book may appear. If he refuses to cooperate, the manuscript stays in a drawer and his passport application is rejected.
b2-szamizdat-02.canDo: I can describe how György Aczél negotiated with writers and film directors over what could be published.

b2-szamizdat-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Between the Lines
b2-szamizdat-03.scenario: After a performance at a Budapest theatre, a foreign guest asks you why plays about the Turkish period meant so much to the audience in the Kádár era.
b2-szamizdat-03.prompt: Explain what the plays seemed to be about and how the audience read them.
cues: Say what the plays seemed to be about
Say how the audience read them
b2-szamizdat-03.target: A darabok a török hódoltságról szóltak, a nézők viszont sorok között olvastak. A virágnyelvet elengedhetetlennek tartották, mert a jelenről nem lehetett nyíltan beszélni.
b2-szamizdat-03.english: The plays were about the Turkish period, but the audience read between the lines. Flower language was considered indispensable, because the present could not be spoken about openly.
b2-szamizdat-03.canDo: I can explain how writers and audiences used 'flower language' (virágnyelv) to speak about taboo subjects such as 1956.

b2-szamizdat-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Stencils in the Kitchen
b2-szamizdat-04.scenario: At an exhibition on samizdat in Budapest, a student asks you how samizdat books were made at home in the 1980s.
b2-szamizdat-04.prompt: Tell her where the books were made, how the copies were produced and what the police did.
cues: Say where the work took place
Say with what the copies were made
b2-szamizdat-04.target: A könyvek a konyhákban és a fürdőszobákban sokszorosodtak, kézi keretekkel és stencilekkel. A rendőrség házkutatásokat tartott, és elkobozta a kiadványokat.
b2-szamizdat-04.english: The books were duplicated in kitchens and bathrooms, with hand frames and stencils. The police carried out house searches and confiscated the publications.
b2-szamizdat-04.canDo: I can describe how samizdat books and periodicals were made in private flats with simple stencils and screen-printing frames (ramka).

b2-szamizdat-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Journal Beszélő
b2-szamizdat-05.scenario: At a history evening in Budapest, a guest asks you what the samizdat journal Beszélő was.
b2-szamizdat-05.prompt: Tell him when Beszélő appeared and what it published about.
b2-szamizdat-05.target: A Beszélő 1981 végén jelent meg illegális folyóiratként. A lapban olyan információk kerültek közzétételre, amelyekről a hivatalos média hallgatott.
b2-szamizdat-05.english: Beszélő appeared at the end of 1981 as an illegal journal. Information was published in it about which the official media were silent.
b2-szamizdat-05.canDo: I can say what the samizdat journal Beszélő published from 1981 and what part it played in the opposition's work.

b2-szamizdat-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Censorship and Samizdat
b2-szamizdat-consolidation.scenario: At a conference on the Kádár era in Budapest, a student asks you to sum up the 'three Ts' and the samizdat.
b2-szamizdat-consolidation.prompt: Tell her how works were classified and how samizdat books were made.
cues: Say how samizdat copies were made
b2-szamizdat-consolidation.target: A műveket a támogatott, a tűrt vagy a tiltott kategóriába sorolták. A szamizdat könyvek titokban, a konyhákban sokszorosodtak.
b2-szamizdat-consolidation.english: Works were sorted into the supported, the tolerated or the prohibited category. Samizdat books were duplicated in secret, in kitchens.
b2-szamizdat-consolidation.canDo: I can sum up how the 'three Ts' worked and how samizdat publishing began in Hungary.
